scope: Codex Dynamic Workflows V3 only. Exact native subscription tuples, local shell and patch tools, and on-demand refresh for dependency-ready tasks.
baseline: The published Codex cell is a fixed, tool-free model and effort with an expiring manual observation.
design: Retain the existing portable selector and lifecycle. Verify native tool and child events, reuse current scope-bound native evidence, and freeze the resulting catalog for the individual task.

live_verification.limits: Live cold and warm paths tested on the named route. Expiry and other exact tuple handling are covered with deterministic controls, and any other tuple requires a native check. Ordinary workload approval settings were preserved.

deterministic_verification: 178 targeted tests and 60 subtests passed, including cache reuse and expiry, profile separation, forged evidence, tool/refusal controls, legacy replay, and task-local catalog identity.
rollback: Reconcile a scoped revert of the adapter and tests. Prior runs retain their original receipts. Runs with on-demand candidate overlays require the matching replay implementation.
limitations: Live worker qualification exercised GPT-6.1 Sol at high effort. Generic acceptance of exact names is covered by deterministic tests. Other tuples must pass their own native probe. External connectors and effects are outside this route.

change_reconciliation.authority: Explicit request to extend Codex Dynamic Workflows for tool use, on-demand availability, and user-selected exact native routes.
change_reconciliation.requirement_reason: The existing durable routed execution contract already permits verified native routes under current task authorization. These changes provide the missing host implementation and document its scope.
change_reconciliation.checks: Real native probe, cache readback, worker result and release, source-bound workflow artifacts, and deterministic controls for mismatch, expiry and replay.

outcome_review.expected: A dependency-ready Codex task selects its exact native tuple only after a fresh or currently verified matching observation, uses its requested local tools, and retains immutable replay.
outcome_review.observed: The qualified native tool worker completed and the controller exited. A second dispatch reused the independently revalidated observation and stored its own effective catalog. A simulated expiry refreshed an unbound dependent task while preserving the upstream receipt.
outcome_review.limitations: Live worker qualification exercised GPT-6.1 Sol at high effort. Generic acceptance of exact names is covered by deterministic tests. Other tuples must pass their own native probe. External connectors and effects are outside this route.

obligations.reason: Existing intent, lifecycle, and neighboring loading obligations still govern this scoped implementation.
